premise: Badger's apple for Beaver is too heavy to carry downhill, so Hedgehog curls up, sticks it on his prickles and rolls it all the way to the pond.
inspiration: The folk tale of the gift that arrives in a funny way, turned so the problem (prickles) becomes the solution.
lesson: What makes you different can be exactly what a friend needs.

en-US.title: Hedgehog Delivers an Apple
en-US.text: Badger {badger:pulse} had picked a big red apple, a present for his friend Beaver. But Beaver's pond was all the way down the hill, and the apple was heavy. [sighs] Oof. Hedgehog {hedgehog:pulse} had an idea. Leave it to me! {hedgehog:live} He gave a little yawn, tucked himself into a tight, prickly ball, peeked out to take aim… and uncurled. Ready! Then he curled up again and rolled right over the apple. {sfx:squish} Squish! It stuck to his prickles. [excited] And down the hill he went, {hedgehog:spin x3} roly-poly, roly-poly, with the apple going round and round on top. {sfx:bump} Bump! He stopped right at the edge of the pond. Beaver {beaver:hop} popped out of the water. [gasps] An apple! [happily] Hedgehog bowed, and the apple dropped right into Beaver's paws. {beaver:hearts} {badger:hearts}

es-ES.title: Erizo reparte una manzana
es-ES.text: Tejón {badger:pulse} había cogido una manzana grande y roja, un regalo para su amigo Castor. Pero la charca de Castor estaba abajo del todo de la colina, y la manzana pesaba mucho. [sighs] Uf. Erizo {hedgehog:pulse} tuvo una idea. ¡Déjamelo a mí! {hedgehog:live} Dio un bostecito, se hizo una bola bien apretada y pinchuda, asomó la nariz para apuntar… y se desenrolló. ¡Listo! Luego se enroscó otra vez y rodó por encima de la manzana. {sfx:squish} ¡Chof! Se le quedó pinchada. [excited] Y colina abajo que se fue, {hedgehog:spin x3} rueda que rueda, rueda que rueda, con la manzana dando vueltas encima. {sfx:bump} ¡Pum! Se paró justo en la orilla de la charca. Castor {beaver:hop} sacó la cabeza del agua. [gasps] ¡Una manzana! [happily] Erizo hizo una reverencia, y la manzana cayó justo en las patas de Castor. {beaver:hearts} {badger:hearts}

squish.prompt: a soft cartoon squish of prickles poking into a crisp apple

bump.prompt: a soft round bump as something rolls to a stop on grass
